props.name: now
props.description: The moment "Today" and the now marker are measured from. Defaults to the clock, re-read each minute.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Called when an event is chosen. Without it, events are plain text.

props.name: stickyHeaders
props.description: Keep each day's heading pinned while its events scroll under it.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Cap the height in pixels and scroll inside.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when there are no events at all.
